title: Practice 1: The present for the future, and «let's go»

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., imper. sg.) погрейся у камина.
exercises.why: **иди** — imperative (ты, singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Come and warm yourself by the fire.

exercises.q: ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., imper. sg.) во двор и поиграй.
exercises.why: **иди** — imperative (ты, singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Не беги, ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., imper. sg.) медленно.
exercises.why: **иди** — imperative (ты, singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., imper. pl.) разбудите его.
exercises.why: **пойдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) посидим в тени.
exercises.why: **пойдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Let's go and sit in the shade.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) по лестнице.
exercises.why: **пойдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Каким путём мы ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.)?
exercises.why: **пойдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Темнеет, ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) домой.
exercises.why: **пойдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: It is getting dark, let's go home.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.) играть в боулинг.
exercises.why: **идём** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Мы с Эстеллой ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.) гулять.
exercises.why: **идём** — present tense (1st person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Estella and I are going for a walk.

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) выпьем по пивку.
exercises.why: **пойдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., imper. sg.) поиграй с Томом.
exercises.why: **пойди** — imperative (ты, singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Давай ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 1st pl.) на лифте.
exercises.why: **поедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out». Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) завтра в казино.
exercises.why: **пойдём** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Let's go to the casino tomorrow.

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., imper. sg.) куда-нибудь ещё.
exercises.why: **пойди** — imperative (ты, singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., imper. pl.) все в луна-парк.
exercises.why: **пойдёмте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Let's all go to Luna Park.

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) повидаемся с ней.
exercises.why: **пойдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Мы ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 1st pl.) в Калифорнию.
exercises.why: **поедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., imper. sg.) с ним в Варшаву.
exercises.why: **поезжай** — imperative (ты, singular) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».

exercises.q: Давай ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 1st pl.) в Тихуану.
exercises.why: **поедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out». Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.
